task_59.description: The benchmark gold label conflicts with the agent behavior or user simulation expectation. This case should be treated separately from normal agent execution errors.
pattern: The mismatch comes from disagreement between simulator expectation and gold trajectory.
Do not classify only based on common business intuition.

verification_rule.failure_condition: Only mark when the trajectory differs from benchmark expected behavior.

task_95.description: Agent misunderstands product variant requirements during exchange.
pattern: Agent ignores required options or attributes.

verification_rule.failure_condition: Replacement item does not satisfy user's requested variant constraints.

task_98.description: Agent fails to correctly handle the scope of user requested operations.
pattern: User requests operation on specific items.
Agent fails to confirm ambiguous scope.

verification_rule.failure_condition: Agent changes items outside user confirmed scope.

task_107.description: Agent performs an action allowed by tools but forbidden by benchmark policy.
pattern: Business policy should prevent the action.

check: Whether action should have been blocked
verification_rule.failure_condition: Tool success but policy violation exists.

important_constraints: Do not introduce external business rules not present in benchmark.
Do not assume common ecommerce policies.
Only classify failure when evidence exists in trajectory or benchmark rules.
Tool success does not guarantee policy correctness.
